    dp."Record_Registry" as flow_id,
    dp.vol_gb * CASE WHEN dp."dataSense" = 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END as dsi,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' as dest_country
FROM "DataProfile" dp
JOIN "DataFlow" df ON dp."Flow_Sign" = df."RecordRegistry"
WHERE dp.vol_gb * CASE WHEN dp."dataSense" = 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END > 100
ORDER BY dsi DESC;

SELECT 
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' as dest_country,
    AVG(df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct') as avg_success_rate,
    COUNT(*) as num_flows
FROM "DataFlow" df
WHERE df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country'
ORDER BY num_flows DESC;
